QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] Violetta's Rescue
QuestInfo.0: Violetta is rushing you to rescue her but it seems impossible unless you can somehow unlock her iron chains.
QuestInfo.1: You need the key to unlock the chain, but it's impossible to know who has the real key. Your best bet is to just eliminate everyone in sight and grab all the keys.
QuestInfo.2: Welp, none of the keys worked. Maybe that wasn't such a great plan. Whose idea was that, anyway?

0.0: You must find a way to unlock these chains. You can do it, my hero! I believe in you!

yes.0: The monsters here have keys, but I don't know which is the right one. Could you get #r20 #t4034112##k items and see if any of them fit?

no.0: A-are you going to ask me to marry you for freeing me? That is too...

1.0: Did you get all the keys? Please try them one by one. I can't wait to be free and in your ar... back in the castle.
1.1: None of them are a match... But we have no time. The Vikings will be here any minute! I guess I have no choice... HRRRRGH!

default.0: Oh my... the Black Viking will not give up so easily! I need the #r#t4034112##k to undo this iron chain.
